prompt: Build a pricing section directly below the features section: a heading, three tiers (Free, Pro, Team) as cards with the price, a short feature list and a call-to-action button each, with Pro highlighted as recommended. Then add an FAQ section with four questions and answers below it. Build it directly on this page now; do not suggest a job.

figcraft.finalText:
I added a pricing section and an FAQ section below the features, both matching the page's existing styling. The pricing section has the heading "Simple, honest pricing" and three cards: Free ($0), Pro ($24) and Team ($49). Each card has a price, a three-item feature list and a button at the bottom. Pro has an indigo border, a "Recommended" badge and a filled button. The FAQ has four question-and-answer cards.

I made up the prices, feature lists and FAQ wording as placeholders, so replace them with your real details.

The pricing row has a fixed height of 400px so the three cards stay equal. If you add more lines to a card, you'll need to raise that height.

I added a pricing section and an FAQ section below Features, and lint found no issues.

- **Pricing:** The heading is followed by Free ($0), Pro ($24) and Team ($79) cards. Each has three bullet features and a button. Pro is highlighted with a primary-color border, a shadow, a "Recommended" badge and the primary button. Free and Team use the secondary button. The cards sit in three columns from the tablet breakpoint (768px) up and stack on mobile.
- **FAQ:** A centered heading with four question-and-answer pairs.

The prices, features and FAQ answers are placeholder copy I wrote, so swap in your real details.
